subject: Marketplace co-sell and SKU revenue split — CloudStride integration
messages:
From: Rachel Park <rachel@cloudstride.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@cloudstride.com>, partnerships@cloudstride.com
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + Marketplace listing / SKU mapping

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking time to chat yesterday — excited about the integration runway. We reviewed the Redwood marketplace listing guide and put together a first-pass SKU proposal and a short solution brief for your team (attached). High level asks: 

- Confirm whether we should publish as a single packaged SKU or split by feature (embedding vs hosted model).
- Clarify Redwood/CSP revenue split expectations for co-sell (we have a suggested rev-share per-SKU in the spreadsheet).
- Any specific evidence you need for the co-sell certification (logs, SOC2 excerpt, architecture diagram).

Can we set a 30-min ops handoff next week to lock the SKU mapping and the marketplace evidence checklist? Our preference is the week of May 24.

Attachments: CloudStride_Redwood_SKU_Proposal.xlsx (xlsx), CloudStride_SolutionBrief.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Rachel Park
Head of Partnerships
CloudStride Solutions
---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Park <rachel@cloudstride.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Marketplace listing / SKU mapping

Hi Rachel — welcome, and thanks for the materials. I reviewed the spreadsheet and the brief; helpful. Quick responses below and a proposed next steps list.

Short answers:
- Packaging: For co-sell we generally recommend separate SKUs for Hosted API vs. Managed on Dedicated (so buyers can choose). If you have a strong upsell path (embeddings add-on) we can map an optional add-on SKU.
- Revenue split: Redwood follows a standard marketplace rev-share baseline but there is room to flex for certified ISVs with joint GTM commitments. We need to formalize the % in the partner contract — ops will need the SKU mapping to generate the offer.
- Evidence: start with SOC2 summary, architecture diagram highlighting data flow, and an end-to-end demo script. For cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP) we also require a brief security Q&A and a billing metering plan.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ops handoff call (30m) — May 25 or 26. Please confirm availability.
2) You share the metering plan and the preferred SKU names in the spreadsheet (we'll validate).
3) Redwood will send our co-sell checklist + the marketplace template (I attached the standard doc).

I've looped in Ben (GTM) and Olga (marketplace ops) so they can prep the evidence list and rev-share flex scenarios.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0193

Attachment: redwood_marketplace_co-sell-template.docx (docx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel@cloudstride.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Marketplace listing / SKU mapping

Looping in Vivek for commercial and partner incentives. A few commercial notes before the handoff:

- GTM commitments: if CloudStride can commit to two joint webinars + co-marketing field events in Q3 we can open a more aggressive rev-share band for their primary SKU. We should put this in the MAP (mutual action plan).
- Bundling: prefer 2 SKUs: "CloudStride Managed (Dedicated)" and "CloudStride Hosted (Redwood API)". Optional embeddings add-on SKU named "CloudStride Embeddings Pack". This simplifies metering and fulfillment across AWS/GCP.
- Contracting: procurement will need the exact SKU codes and an expected ARR estimate to model marketplace pricing tiers. Ops, please confirm whether we can create a temporary promo SKU for launch discounts.

Olga — can you run the attached spreadsheet against our marketplace SKU template and call out any naming conflicts or meter incompatibilities? Vivek — I think commercial flexibility here is helpful, but want your read on the ARR threshold for the higher rev-share band.

Thanks,
Ben
VP Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Park <rachel@cloudstride.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Marketplace listing / SKU mapping

Rachel — great sync today, appreciate the quick alignment. Summary + agreed next steps below (pulling from the call notes).

Summary of decisions:
- SKUs to publish at launch (final names to be validated in spreadsheet):
  * CloudStride Hosted (Redwood API) — metered by token/60s burst window
  * CloudStride Managed (Dedicated) — metered by instance-hours with a reserved capacity SKU
  * CloudStride Embeddings Pack — optional add-on metered per-embedding-unit
- Commercial commitments: CloudStride will commit to two joint webinar slots and three co-marketing blog posts in Q3 to qualify for the elevated rev-share band. Ben will document the exact rev-share bands in the MAP.
- Evidence pack required for marketplace listing: SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, billing metering plan, end-to-end demo script, short security Q&A (answers to our standard template).

Action items and owners (dates):
- CloudStride: update SKU tab in spreadsheet with final SKU codes and provide metering plan (due 2027-05-25). (Rachel / Tom)
- Olga: run SKU names through marketplace validator and return any renames/constraints (due 2027-05-27).
- Soojin: circulate MAP draft + HubSpot deal link and attach Redwood's co-sell evidence checklist (today).
- Ben/Vivek: confirm ARR threshold for elevated rev-share (Ben/Vivek to confirm by 2027-05-26).

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/CS-2027-0417
Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/marketplace-evidence-CloudStride

Next meeting: Ops handoff 30m on May 26 at 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent.

Thanks all — looking forward to launch.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
